value.name: Alice shows fight lobby card
value.description: Alice proudly presents a lobby card advertising the Ward vs. Belinc fight to the group.
evidence: Alice pulls out a LOBBY CARD, "WARD VS. BELINC - FOXWOODS RESORT as she sits in a large booth with George, Mickey O'Keefe, Red Dog, Sherry.

value.name: Micky arrives with Charlene
value.description: Micky enters the restaurant accompanied by Charlene and joins the booth.
evidence: MICKY (kisses his mother hello, SITS DOWN)

value.name: Alice asks about Dicky's arrival
value.description: Alice says Dicky is expected soon, keeping the family focused on the fight gathering.
evidence: ALICE (looks at watch) He'll be here.

value.name: Charlene reveals she plans to quit the bar
value.description: Charlene says she has quit the bar job and wants to pursue teacher certification instead.
evidence: CHARLENE She did. But she's wants to quit to go for teachah certification.

value.name: Alice jokes Charlene lives off Micky
value.description: Alice makes a cutting joke that Charlene plans to live off Micky, prompting tension.
evidence: ALICE (CHUCKLES) I thought she was plannin' to live offa Micky.

value.name: Micky redirects conversation to the fight
value.description: Micky tries to stop the family banter and steer the table back to the upcoming fight.
evidence: MICKY C'mon, c'mon, this is 'sposed to be about the fight, let's just talk about the fight --

value.name: Charlene snaps back at Alice
value.description: Charlene answers Alice's joke by accusing her of trying to live off Micky for years.
evidence: CHARLENE It's OK, I know you been tryin' to live offa Micky for years.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe asks about press conference
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe changes the subject by asking whether there will be a press conference.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE (changing the topic) Is there gonna be a press conference?

value.name: Alice confirms press conference timing
value.description: Alice answers that the press conference will be held five days before the fight.
evidence: ALICE Yeah, five days before the fight --
